name: ETF-ownership tracking infrastructure -- opal-data-etfs bucket, per-partner daily-ownership producers, IAM, ETF-universe config, 49F silver/RPS build
description: Andrew-direct 2026-06-22 ('the SETUP PRD is putting together any necessary infrastructure/AWS resources to facilitate this process, including the bucket, any lambdas that track daily average ownership per partner, etc.'). The INFRA FOUNDATION under ETFS_AVGCAP. Stands up: (1) opal-data-etfs aggregation bucket; (2) IAM on the WRITE-OUT model -- each partner's daily-producer role WRITEs only its own opal-data-etfs/daily/{partner}/* prefix + READs only its own firm bucket; the AVGCAP reader READs opal-data-etfs ONLY with ZERO firm-bucket grants (clean NEVER#1: no cross-firm READ ever, so the firm-bucket Deny statements are never fought -- comp-iam gaps confirmed firm buckets carry Deny on their own ARN); (3) three per-partner DAILY ETF-ownership producer lambdas (Inflection reads opal-data-inf gold/holdings; Cottonwood reads opal-data-cot gold/canonical/holdings post-COTETL-fix; 49F reads opal-data-schwab silver/RPS) that filter to the 4 Opal ETFs (DIVZ/IDVZ/PFDE/PFOE), sum market_value per ETF, and write the daily artifact; (4) the 49F silver/RPS build -- productionize the AE-owned /49-schwab-conv RPS converter (silver/RPS is currently EMPTY) + register it as the canonical 49F positions producer->served thread (currently ungraphed); (5) a shared ETF-universe config (not hardcoded x3); (6) the daily-artifact schema contract {partner,date,etf,ownership_value,account_count,source_artifact,source_as_of} that ETFS_AVGCAP consumes (source_as_of carries true vintage for honest staleness -- the COTETL serve-time-vintage lesson).
